method: Delivery probe output for every candidate the ads.txt and Certificate Transparency passes produced. A declaration names the company that sells inventory, which is often not the domain that delivers the advertising - OpenX declares openx.com and bids from openx.net - so a root earns a rule only when it answers on a conventional delivery, bidding, syncing or creative hostname. A root that answers only on its apex is a corporate website and is recorded here as such. This is the verdict the candidate lists do not carry.
